svg.title: Who I am: from gears to graphs
svg.desc: Bio: senior software engineer with 10+ years across the full software development life cycle, mechanical engineer by degree. Builds FastAPI microservices on AWS EKS/ECS serving ML forecasting models at Freddie Mac; previously helped build and support a 50+ AWS microservice platform at Capital One. Signature numbers: 10+ years, 50+ AWS microservices, a 3,000 to 1,000 line Python refactor with 20% better performance, over 85% PyTest coverage on new code, led backend teams at Freddie Mac and Humana and API development at CVS Health. A rotating armillary sphere shows five domains: finance, healthcare, retail, pharma, insurance.
